<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown report --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown report [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--html`
: HTML instead of Markdown.

`-o`, `--output <OUTPUT>`
: Write to this file instead of the terminal.

`--refresh`
: Recognise every drive again first.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

The report reads the index as it is; run `backdown hash` (or `check`/`dupes`) first so every duplicate is counted.

## Examples

```sh
backdown report > report.md
backdown report --html -o report.html
```
